instruction:
Task: After selecting a circle, interact with the UI color picker control to change its color.
Expected Result: The selected circle's color on the canvas updates in real-time to reflect the color chosen in the color picker.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: The selected circle's color on the canvas updates in real-time to reflect the color chosen in the color picker.
